label: preparing
what: Likely a coordinated private gathering or event involving a large 200-loaf bread order, wheat procurement and hauling, and possibly great-hall lighting. Baker and neighbour have been reported together; freight supplied payment and wheat, and innkeeper reportedly promised thirty emeralds. Builder and secretary are arranging a hall lighting inspection, though its connection to the private order is uncertain. The exact event and full membership have not been disclosed to me.
